_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
U sechaba {player_id} papaling ea LinesOfAction.
Masimula a hao ke '{side}', masimula a mmotsana ke '{other}'.
Fomate ea tsela: `[b1b3]` (koordinate ea qhobosheaneng ea sebakeng). Tsela e ntle e ea horisontally, vertically, kapa diagonally ka palo e lekanang ea masimula (mohlodi o mong le o mong) ka mstari oo. U ka hopola masimula a hao, empa eseng masimula a mmotsana; ho theoha holim'a mmotsana o mo tshwara.  U hloleha ha masimula a hao a hokahaneng ka 8.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopeho se tlameha ho ba e2e4 (ho tloha,to coordinates).
invalid_move.no_piece: Ha ho na {side} karolo e mabapi le {coord}.
invalid_move.identical: Mohloli le sebaka seo ba eang ho sona li tšoana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ho falla ho tlameha hore e be ka kotloloho kapa ka lehlakoreng le fapaneng.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: E tlameha ho tsamaea sebaka se lekanang le likotoana tse tsamaellanang.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Lithunya tsa sera li thibile tsela.
invalid_move.destination_own: Sebaka seo se eang ho sona se hapiloe ke sesole sa rōna.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} e tsamaisa {from} -> {to} e fumana motho wa kgale.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Ho tsamaisoa ka makhetlo a 60 empa ho sa tšoaroa.
outcome.draw_repetition: Boemo bo phetoa ka makhetlo a mararo.
